_about: The Basic Actions (Core Rules, Chapter 6). One source per card: book/cards/README.md says what each field means. The book renders a card where its chapter writes @@CARD:Name@@; Foundry builds module/basic-data.mjs from it (node tools/gen-basic.mjs); the ruler reads it (spec.mjs).

cards.name: Advance
cards.flavor: You press forward, one deliberate step at a time.

versions.effects: You Advance your Speed. Once during it you can use Interact (see [[Advance]]).

cards.name: Charge
cards.flavor: You close the distance in one straight, reckless line.

versions.effects: Advance in a [[Straight Line|straight line]] toward the target, at least 3 squares and up to your Speed, and stop on the first square from which the target is within the melee Range of the Melee weapon you attack with (a [[Thrown]] weapon used in hand). You can't Charge through Difficult Terrain (an ally's space is Difficult Terrain) or an enemy's space, even if you have movement left: the Charge ends in the last **empty** square where the line is legal. At the end of your movement, make a Basic Attack (1A) with 1 Boon against the target, with that weapon. That Basic Attack counts toward At-will Banes.

cards.name: Crawl
cards.flavor: You drag yourself along the ground.

cards.name: Evade
cards.flavor: You slip through the fray without giving anyone an opening.

cards.name: Fists
cards.flavor: When there is nothing else in your hands, there are always your hands.
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3): Fists use fixed numbers (Option B with exploding die: [V] 1 / 2 + [Mod] / 1d6! + [Mod] Bl).

cards.name: Haul
cards.flavor: You snag them and drag them in.
cards.requirements: Your Reach is 2 or more. The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours and is at least 2 squares away.
cards.notes: You can't choose your own square as the destination.
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3; cards/basic-actions-redesign.md): Body only (was Appeal or Body), no [Strike].

cards.name: Interact
cards.flavor: You pull the lever, open the door, grab what you need.
cards.notes: While you are Hidden or Unsensed, a quiet use (taking an item you carry, opening a door slowly) is Subtle if the GM agrees; the GM can call for a Check.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: draw an object you carry into a free hand; stow an object you hold (put it away on your person, such as sheathing a sword); swap two objects (stow the one you hold and draw another, in the same Action; stowing and swapping need no free hand); grab objects within Reach, as many as you have free hands; help a Prone creature within Reach stand up; help an Imperiled creature within Reach get to safety; wake an Unconscious creature within Reach; open a door, chest or something similar. This Action is broader than most: it can be used for similar things in the world. You can use it once during an Advance Action without ending the Advance (see [[Advance]]).

cards.name: Lean
cards._note: 2026-11-21 (Lucas, playtest 7; the core rework B12): the Action is Lean, the state stays Leaning; it ends when you leave your square.
cards.flavor: You lean out from cover, just enough to see.

versions.effects: Until the end of your turn, or until you leave your square (any movement: an Advance, an Evade, a Forced Movement), you are Leaning: you count Line of Effect and Cover from one of your corners instead of the center of your square, and your own cover against other creatures' Actions is reduced by 1 level (Total → High → Medium → Low → none). A creature leaning out of Total cover becomes High cover (still targetable). You can stop Leaning at any time on your turn, at no cost.

cards.name: Regrip
cards.flavor: You shift your hands on the grip, and the weapon sits where you want it.

versions.effects: You do one of the following: hold a weapon you hold in one hand with both hands (your other hand must be free); move a weapon from one hand to the other; or swap the weapons in your two hands.

cards.name: Release
cards.flavor: You let it go.

versions.effects: You drop an object you hold, in your square, or take one hand off an object you hold with both hands (a Two-handed weapon is then held in one hand).

cards.name: Reload
cards.flavor: You work the mechanism and seat a fresh bolt.
cards.target: You, or one ally within Reach, holding a weapon that must be Reloaded
cards.rules: With a ranged weapon Reload is a [Ranged] Action: its roll is Doomed while you are Engaged.

tiers: Your next Reload attempt gains 2 Boons.
You Reload the weapon. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.
You Reload the weapon and its wielder can Evade 1. Then you can Regrip (1A) to hold the weapon with two hands, or the ally can.

cards.name: Relocate
cards.flavor: You take them by the arm and put them where you want them.
cards.vs: Body or Instinct (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.

cards.name: Shake Off
cards.flavor: You beat out the flames, press on the wound, scrape off what burns.
cards.target: You, or one Lingering creature within your Reach
cards.vs: The better of the [[Lingering]]'s two Attributes, against DC 13 or the DC the Lingering writes Save

tiers: The target takes half the Lingering at the end of the current turn (whoever's turn it is), then the Lingering ends.

foundry.text: The target makes a Save against its [[Lingering]], with the better of the Lingering's two Attributes, against DC 13 or the DC the Lingering writes. **Tier 1:** no effect. **Tier 2:** it takes half the Lingering at the end of the current turn (whoever's turn it is), then the Lingering ends. **Tier 3:** the Lingering ends.

cards.name: Shove
cards.flavor: You put your weight behind it and drive them back.
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3; cards/basic-actions-redesign.md): no [Strike]; two Versions (the 2 AP one buys a Tier 1); Pushed 2 / 3 at 1 AP.

cards.name: Stand
cards.flavor: You get your feet back under you.

versions.effects: You stand up: you are no longer Prone.

cards.name: Steel Yourself
cards.flavor: You grit your teeth and find a little more to give.
cards.notes: You can't use this Action while Down (Desperate, Dying or Shattered) or Unconscious.

cards.name: Trip
cards.flavor: A hooked foot, a twist, and they hit the ground.
cards.vs: Body or Instinct (the one used to roll)
cards.requirements: The target's SR is at most 1 higher than yours.
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3; cards/basic-actions-redesign.md): no [Strike]; Prone on a Tier 2 at 1 AP; the 2 AP Version buys a Tier 1 (Hindered).

cards.name: Basic Attack
cards.flavor: You strike with the weapon in your hands.
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3; cards/basic-actions-redesign.md): the Weapon Attack renamed Basic Attack (shared by every PC; each class adds a line to it); Tier 1 [Mod], Tier 3 1[W] + 1[D] + [Mod].

cards.name: Break Free
cards._note: v0.0.224 (Lucas, playtest 3): removing Immobilized costs 1 AP and is a Move Action (08-conditions.md, Immobilized). v0.0.431 (the book audit, Q9 and Q10): shown in Chapter 6; Prone allows it; a Grab can ask for a Check. 2026-11-20 (Lucas): always a Body or Instinct Check against the Immobilized DC; the same day the Immobilized DC became the Action DC (Chapter 1). 2026-11-21 (Lucas, playtest 7; the core rework B11): written in Tiers with a Check line; Doubles raise the Tier as on any roll; Self is its Distance, not a trait.
cards.flavor: You tear loose from whatever holds you.

versions.effects: You are no longer Immobilized, and no longer Grabbed if you were.

foundry.automationNote: the core rework B11: using it rolls the Body or Instinct Check (you choose: the roll dialog has a Roll button for each, the higher first) against the Action DC of what holds you (the highest on your Immobilized conditions; 13 with no Action behind it); a Tier 2 or 3 (Doubles count) ends Immobilized and Grabbed.

cards.name: Aid
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3; cards/basic-actions-redesign.md): the AP handed over (Quickened 1); Lucas added Focus, Instinct and the Check against Daunted's Action DC.
cards.flavor: You call the opening, and a friend takes it.
cards.target: One ally that can hear you

versions.effects: The target is Quickened 1 on its next turn.

cards.notes: If the target is Daunted, you also make an Appeal or Instinct Check against the Action DC of the Action that Daunted it: on a Tier 2 or 3, the target is no longer Daunted.

foundry.automationNote: Quickened 1 on the target (its next turn's AP); the Check against Daunted: by hand.

cards.name: Demoralize
cards._note: 2026-11-24 (Lucas, Playtest 8 Pass 1): T2 Vulnerable 1 (EoT), T3 Vulnerable 1 (1 round), target immune to your Demoralize (EoE).
cards.flavor: You fix them with a look and a promise, and their guard slips.
cards.target: One creature that can see or hear you
cards.notes: After you use Demoralize on a creature, whatever the Tier, you can't use it on that creature again this encounter.

foundry.automationNote: Vulnerable 1 (EoT on Tier 2, 1 round on Tier 3); warns in the roll dialog if you target a creature already immune to your Demoralize this encounter.

cards.name: Feint
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3; cards/basic-actions-redesign.md): Tier 2 gives 2 Boons on your next Strike against the target this turn, Tier 3 makes it Favored; the Critical stops its Reactions against you. 2026-11-26 (Lucas, after playtests 8 to 10: "Likely make 2 Boons on Tier 3, not favored"): Tier 2 gives 1 Boon, Tier 3 gives 2 Boons (the Tier 2's 1 Boon is Claude's split).
cards.flavor: You show one blow and land another.

tiers: You gain 1 Boon on your next [Strike] Action against the target this turn.
You gain 2 Boons on your next [Strike] Action against the target this turn.
versions.critical: Until the end of your turn, the target can't use a Reaction for which you are the triggering creature.

foundry.automationNote: applies 1 Boon (Tier 2) or 2 Boons (Tier 3) on your next [Strike] Action against the target this turn, and blocks its Reactions against you until EoT on a Critical.

cards.name: Tend
cards._note: 2026-11-24 (Lucas, Playtest 8 Pass 1): 2 AP, Handle kept, Mind or Appeal vs DC 13; T1 1 RP, T2 2 RP, T3 2 RP + can Stand if Prone.
cards.flavor: You press, bind and talk them back to their feet.

tiers: The target can use 1 Rally Point.
The target can use 2 Rally Points.
The target can use 2 Rally Points, and if it is Prone it can Stand.

foundry.automationNote: the Check against DC 13 and the Rally Point button on the card; standing from Prone on Tier 3 by hand.

cards.name: Tumble
cards._note: 2026-11-22 (Lucas, the core rework batch 3; cards/basic-actions-redesign.md): Lucas's shape; Appeal or Instinct; no Difficult Terrain on a Tier 2 (Claude).
cards.flavor: You duck, roll and slip past them.
cards.rules: You can move through enemies' spaces (never ending in one). An enemy's space you pass this way costs 1 square. Before you move, make an Appeal or Instinct Check against the same Attribute's DC of the creatures whose spaces your path crosses (the highest), with 1 Bane for each creature beyond the first: on a Tier 1 you stop in the last square before the first enemy's space and your movement ends; on a Tier 2 or 3 you pass. Passing diagonally between two enemies corner to corner counts as crossing one creature: the higher of their DCs, no Bane for the second.

foundry.automationNote: the movement (the Advance or the Evade) passes enemies' spaces and the diagonal between two of them (never ending in one); the card posts first: its Appeal Check and Instinct Check roll against the targeted creatures' DC of that Attribute (the highest, 1 Bane for each creature beyond the first; no target: DC 13), then its Move button.

cards.name: Hide
cards._note: 2026-11-24 (Lucas, the Hide package; research/hide-and-stealth.md; rules-backlog.md): applied 2026-11-25. It targets creatures, not enemies (an ally too); rolled once for all of them (Several Targets).
cards.flavor: You drop out of sight, still your breath, and let the shadows take you.
cards.target: Each creature that can't see you, or against which you have High Cover (no Line of Effect needed)
cards.rules: Senses don't change this roll: you don't need to perceive the targets.

tiers: If the creature can't see you, you are Unsensed to it; otherwise you are Hidden to it (see [[Hiding]]).
If the creature can't see you, you are Unsensed to it; otherwise you are Hidden to it. It takes 1 Bane on Seek and Point Out against you (1 round).

foundry.automationNote: the roll against each targeted creature's Instinct DC (target them first); Tier 2 or 3 makes you Unsensed (it can't see you) or Hidden (your High Cover) to that creature from Hide (senses.mjs, per creature); Tier 3's Bane on its Seek and Point Out: by hand.

cards.name: Point Out
cards._note: 2026-11-24 (Lucas, the Hide package): renamed from Call Out (Spotter's Mode had that name); applied 2026-11-25.
cards.flavor: A sharp shout and a pointed glance, and now everyone knows where they are.
cards.requirements: You perceive the target better than at least one ally does.
cards.target: One creature you perceive (no Line of Effect needed)

tiers: One ally within 10 squares who can see or hear you perceives the target 1 step better: Unsensed becomes Hidden, whatever the reason; Hidden from Hide goes back to what its own senses give. Never better than you perceive it.

Every ally within 10 squares who can see or hear you perceives the target 1 step better: Unsensed becomes Hidden, whatever the reason; Hidden from Hide goes back to what its own senses give. Never better than you perceive it.

foundry.automationNote: the roll against the target's Instinct DC; Tier 2: pick one ally within 10 squares, Tier 3: every ally within 10 squares: it perceives the target 1 step better, Unsensed becoming Hidden whatever the reason (Hide, Darkness, a wall: kept while the target stays in its square), never better than you perceive it (hide.mjs pointOut); whether the ally can see or hear you: by hand.

cards.name: Seek
cards._note: 2026-11-24 (Lucas, the Hide package); applied 2026-11-25. Its roll ignores Senses (Claude's assumption: you seek what you don't perceive).
cards.flavor: You stop, listen, and scan the room for the slightest shift.
cards.target: Each creature Hidden or Unsensed to you from Hide within 5 squares (1 AP) or 10 squares (2 AP) (no Line of Effect needed)
cards.rules: Senses don't change this roll: you don't need to perceive the targets, and the roll isn't Doomed against a Hidden one.

tiers: You perceive the target 1 step better (Unsensed to Hidden, or Hidden from Hide back to your own senses), up to what your senses allow.
You perceive the target 1 step better (Unsensed to Hidden, or Hidden from Hide back to your own senses), up to what your senses allow, and you gain 1 Boon on Point Out against it (EoT).
You perceive the target 1 step better (Unsensed to Hidden, or Hidden from Hide back to your own senses), up to what your senses allow.
You perceive the target 1 step better (Unsensed to Hidden, or Hidden from Hide back to your own senses), up to what your senses allow, and you gain 1 Boon on Point Out against it (EoT).

foundry.automationNote: targets by itself the creatures Hidden or Unsensed to you from Hide within 5 or 10 squares, rolls against each one's Instinct DC with no Senses modifiers, and improves your perception of each on a Tier 2 or 3; Tier 3's Boon on Point Out: by hand.

cards.name: Sneak
cards.flavor: You slip from shadow to shadow, careful where every foot falls.
cards.requirements: You are Hidden or Unsensed to at least one creature from Hide.
cards.rules: This movement doesn't trigger Reactions from creatures to which you are Hidden from Hide. Against a creature to which you are Unsensed from Hide, you stay Unsensed only if it can't see you at any point of the movement; otherwise you are Hidden to it. Against a creature to which you are Hidden from Hide, you stay Hidden during the movement; if you end it without High Cover against that creature and it can see you, Hide ends against it at the end of your turn (or sooner, if something else ends it).

foundry.automationNote: the Advance (half your Speed) keeps Hide: an Unsensed creature that sees you during it makes you Hidden, a Hidden one keeps you Hidden until your turn ends; creatures you are Hidden to don't react to it; the end of turn check without High Cover (senses.mjs).
